ABOUT XPRESS

Made for your
next chapter.

A student resource guide that brings school information, local scholarships, career pathways, and district tools into one place.

How this guide is put together.

Sources, not guesswork.

School names and categories follow the district directory. Contacts come from the 2026–27 district list. Choice and pathway descriptions are based on district program pages. We distinguish hosted programs from separate campus entries.

Scholarship data has a date.

The local scholarship records use factual award amounts and concise eligibility notes from ISF’s 2026 award listing. They are historical reference entries, not assertions of an open application. New cycles may change amounts, availability, or requirements. Program guides are also subject to current provider rules.

Search and school filters help you explore; they do not determine eligibility. Read the provider’s full requirements before applying. This is a downloadable snapshot, not a live-updating service.

Your shortlist stays with you.

Xpress has no sign-up form or backend. Saved scholarship IDs and checklist choices are stored in this browser, when browser storage is available. Nothing is sent to Xpress. Google Fonts may load typefaces online; system fonts work offline. External services have their own privacy practices.

Independent by design.

Irving ISD Xpress is not an official district website or a scholarship administrator. The original Xpress mark is used instead of a district seal. Official district and provider pages control admissions, enrollment, courses, awards, and services.
